name: tsp-torrent-search-api
description: Present for one reason: the `cloudflare.bindings` entry is the text the Deploy to Cloudflare form shows beside TSP_APIKEY. There is nothing to install and nothing to build; the button deploys worker.js as it is. (`type` is here because this file shadows the repository's own for worker.js, and Node would otherwise guess.)

TSP_APIKEY.description: The key your client will send. Any long random string; the [setup page](https://momzv2022-ctrl.github.io/tsp-torrent-search-api/) generates one. Save it: the Worker's own page shows it back only to a request that already has it.
